name: sharepoint_search
description:
Search the configured SharePoint site via the Microsoft Graph search API (documents, list items, sites), or the directory for people.
Returns {query, total_results, result_count, results: [{title, path (URL), author, modified, size, summary, content_class}], success, execution_time_ms}; people: [{title, email, job_title, department, id}]; or {success: false, error}.
Inputs (* required): query* (string, KQL; * for everything), search_type (all | documents | people | sites; default all), file_types (array of extensions such as docx, pdf), max_results (1-500, default 50), start_row (offset for paging, default 0).
Limited to the configured site; people search covers the tenant. Folder browsing: sharepoint_documents.
Example: {"query": "quarterly risk report", "search_type": "documents", "file_types": ["pdf"]}
Needs SHAREPOINT_SITE_URL, AZURE_TENANT_ID, SHAREPOINT_CLIENT_ID, SHAREPOINT_CLIENT_SECRET (Entra ID app); unset, it answers 'SharePoint is not configured'.

search_type.description: What to search: all (files, list items, sites), documents, people or sites

start_row.description: Offset of the first result, for paging
